name: USDKG
oneLiner: USDKG is Gold Dollar's Kyrgyz-Republic-licensed dollar stablecoin backed by ~376 kg of physical LBMA gold bars custodied via state enterprise Kyrgyzaltyn.
collateral: Physical gold bars (~376 kg, 30 bars) sourced from the Kyrgyz Ministry of Finance via state gold enterprise Kyrgyzaltyn (LBMA Good Delivery listed); stored in sealed boxes at an unnamed bank under custody of LLC Virelint Group
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption against USD, Kyrgyzstani som, physical gold, or approved cryptocurrencies through Gold Dollar; KYC/AML verification required for all redemptions

genius.issuerEntity: OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer (state-owned, Ministry of Finance of the Kyrgyz Republic); Gold Dollar operates the issuance; LLC Virelint Group previously cited as operator
genius.licensingRegulator: Ministry of Finance of the Kyrgyz Republic
genius.notes: USDKG is commodity-backed (physical LBMA gold) but USD-referenced and issuer-redeemable; the gold backing raises a question whether it qualifies as a payment stablecoin under GENIUS (which targets fiat-referenced instruments), but no definitive exclusion exists and the USD peg makes apparent-payment-stablecoin the more conservative classification. No public GENIUS approval, PPSI application, or foreign-issuer exception was found. The issuer is a Kyrgyz state-owned entity (OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer) with no known U.S. regulatory presence. Listed on Hong Kong's OSL HK exchange (May 2026) — no U.S. regulatory event. No OFAC, FinCEN, or enforcement action found.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDKG has no cross-chain bridge: it is a standalone Tether-style token issued and burned natively on each chain by the issuer (Gold Dollar / OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer) via issue()/redeem() functions, with separate, non-identical contract addresses on Ethereum (0xe820...45e3) and Tron (TXZo12...nwEG). Supply on each chain is independently issuer-minted against gold reserves with no cross-chain dependency, so the route is single-chain-or-native rather than opaque.

controls.evidence: Gold Dollar operates the centralized 1:1 mint/redeem for USDKG against custodied physical gold, with KYC/AML required for all redemptions; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

controls.label: USDKG Ethereum token owner (3-of-7 multisig)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530817, owner() on USDKG token 0xe820...45e3 returned 0xcF355a...7377. getOwners() returned seven owners and getThreshold() returned 3. The verified token and multisig bytecode expose no upgrade or module path; issue() and redeem() are owner-gated.

controls.label: USDKG Tron token owner (3-of-7 multisig)
controls.evidence: At Tron block 84453790, owner() on TXZo12...nwEG returned 0x34b436...4fd5, the Tron address TEmt2R...A8jd. The verified owner contract ABI and current constant calls returned seven owners (TVZwUL...Jao, TQHTXd...XLU, TXAjos...WDG, TSfP1D...8vB, TZ5KnE...aXL, TMy7WS...bKw, and TEPMSb...AZv) and getThreshold() = 3. The custom multisig has no owner-management, module, or guard functions, and the token's issue() and redeem() functions are owner-gated.

review.evidence: Gold Dollar is the sole issuer of USDKG and operates native owner-gated issue/redeem contracts on Ethereum and Tron. Current reads resolve separate 3-of-7 multisigs on both deployments. Verified bytecode and storage show direct immutable contracts rather than proxy deployments. The only public reserve audit for USDKG is a single Kreston Global ISRS 4400 agreed-upon-procedures gold review valued at 2025-11-28; despite a claimed quarterly cadence no newer report was found as of 2026-07, making the sole reconciliation stale and agreed-upon-procedures lighter than an attestation opinion, so reconciliation is not credibly established. The Kyrgyz oversight regimes checked are AML/VASP-only and the nominal regulator (Ministry of Finance) also owns the issuing state entity, so there is no arms-length prudential supervisor and supervision is none.

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: (1) Kreston Digital Assets Ltd ISRS 4400 (Revised) Agreed-Upon Procedures PDF states gold reserves held on 28 Nov 2025 are the backing asset for USDKG, documents hand-over of 30 bars totaling around 376 kg via LLC Virelint Group into bank storage in 15 sealed boxes, and values the gold at $50,331,256 (LBMA $4,163.475/oz) with no non-gold reserve category in scope. (2) usdkg.com/transparency still presents a single Reserves Composition category—Collateralization (Gold) $54.8M against USDKG in Circulation $50M—indexes the same Q4/November 2025 Kreston PDF, and states quarterly audits verify circulating tokens remain fully backed by physical gold reserves. (3) Issuer audit summary (2025-12-08) independently restates Kreston's AUP covering existence, ownership, quantity, valuation, serial/purity documentation, sealed storage, transport records, and custody agreements for the same 30-bar / ~376 kg physical gold stock, and states the stablecoin is backed entirely by physical gold. Composition remains a single 100% physical-gold slice; no second asset class is disclosed. The active reserve-risk rubric classifies physical bullion as very-low risk; structured risk factors retain gold-market, physical-custody, counterparty, legal, redemption-liquidity, and concentration exposures. Formal quantity pin remains the 2025-11-28 AUP; live portal figures still show gold-only collateralization. Lockstep pin 2026-08-08: compositionAsOf anchored to the November 2025 Kreston AUP that latestReport records - the only artefact valuing the gold ($50.3M, 30 bars ~376kg); the composition is a single allocated-gold category and the live transparency page read of 2026-07-28 is retained as corroboration of category continuity, not of quantity.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Kreston Digital Assets ISRS 4400 gold verification as of 28 November 2025 (single physical-gold category), corroborated by the live gold-only page
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class remains unidentified; current bar-level public allocation, named depository bank, custody concentration, and holder redemption timing remain outside the composition percentage.
